articles.title: Do Value Vectors in Deep Layers Need Context from the Residual Stream?
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.02780v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The success of the transformer architecture as the backbone of modern LLMs is in large part due to its use of attention layers. An attention layer follows the standard neural network paradigm: it takes the residual stream as input and thereby produces context-dependent query, key, and value vectors. However, we find that model performance meaningfully improves when deeper layers learn only a context-free value vector to preserve the original token
articles.title_cn: Transformer 深层 Value 向量可脱离上下文？
articles.summary_cn: 研究者发现 Transformer 深层注意力中的 value 向量对残差流上下文的依赖明显弱于浅层，这一发现挑战了注意力层必须依赖上下文的传统认知，为简化深层计算、降低推理开销提供了理论基础。
articles.why_it_matters: 深入理解注意力机制可指导 LLM 架构简化，降低推理成本

articles.title: Automated Report-Derived Oncology VQA Benchmark for Evaluating Vision-Language Models on 3D Medical Imaging
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.02809v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Evaluating vision-language models (VLMs) on medical images requires benchmarks that are clinically grounded, scalable, and controlled for evaluation confounds. Existing public benchmarks are limited in scale, manually annotated, or potentially leaked into VLM pretraining corpora. articles.title_cn: 自动化肿瘤 VQA：3D 医学影像评估新基准
articles.summary_cn: 提出自动化 Agent pipeline 从临床报告生成肿瘤学 VQA 基准，解决了医学影像评估数据稀缺、人工标注昂贵且易泄露的问题，为 VLM 在 3D 医学影像上的评测提供了可扩展方案。
articles.why_it_matters: 自动化 benchmark 生成是医学 AI 迈向临床落地的关键一步

articles.title: MiniMax-M3 debuts, eclipsing GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro on key benchmark performance for just 5-10% of the cost
articles.summary: Big news in enterprise AI broke over the weekend as Chinese AI startup MiniMax released its highly anticipated M3 large language model on Sunday evening Eastern time, pairing frontier-tier coding and agentic performance with a 1-million-token context window and native multimodality for a fraction of the cost of leading proprietary models, with pricing starting at just $20 per month under its new subscription token plans. The company's leadership also announced plans to deliver the model und
articles.title_cn: MiniMax M3发布：性能超越GPT-5.5且成本仅5-10%
articles.summary_cn: 中国AI公司MiniMax发布M3大语言模型，在多项关键基准测试中超越GPT-5.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro，推理成本仅为竞品的5-10%，在编码和推理任务上达到前沿水平，引发全球AI行业震动。
articles.why_it_matters: 中国企业首次在旗舰模型上全面超越OpenAI和Google，全球LLM竞争格局生变

articles.title: Distilling LLM Feedback for Lean Theorem Proving
articles.summary:
arXiv:2605.30861v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Post-training for reasoning models typically combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, most commonly with GRPO. articles.title_cn: 蒸馏 LLM 反馈提升 Lean 定理证明
articles.summary_cn: 在 Lean 定理证明任务中，用 LLM 生成反馈信号蒸馏为小模型训练数据，替代传统基于可验证奖励的强化学习，在保持证明质量的同时大幅提升训练效率，为数学推理模型训练开辟新路径。
articles.why_it_matters: LLM 反馈蒸馏为数学推理模型的高效训练提供可行方案

articles.title: Fixing FOLIO and MALLS: Verified Annotations and an LLM-assisted Framework to Focus Human Relabeling
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.02837v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Accurate translation from Natural Language to First-Order Logic (NL-to-FOL) underpins neurosymbolic AI systems and Natural Language Inference (NLI), making the quality of NL-to-FOL benchmarks essential -- yet these datasets have never been rigorously audited. articles.title_cn: FOLIO+MALLS 标注审计：LLM 辅助修复逻辑基准
articles.summary_cn: 首次系统性审计两个主流 NL-to-FOL 数据集的标注质量，发现大量错误标注。提出 LLM 辅助框架聚焦人工重标注，显著提升逻辑推理 benchmark 的可靠性，对神经符号 AI 研究有重要意义。
articles.why_it_matters: 基础 benchmark 的标注质量直接决定 AI 逻辑推理研究的可信度

articles.title: Diffusion Image Generation with Explicit Modeling of Data Manifold Geometry
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.00094v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Image generative models aim to sample data points from the underlying data manifold, a task that requires learning and decoding a dense, low-dimensional, and compact parameterization space. To achieve this, we propose the Data Manifold-aware Image diffusioN moDel (MIND), a novel framework that explicitly models manifold geometry by integrating discrete patch tokenization into the score function of a continuous diffusion model. articles.title_cn: 显式建模数据流形几何的图像扩散生成
articles.summary_cn: 提出显式建模数据流形几何结构的扩散模型新方法，通过理解数据在低维流形上的分布特征改进生成质量，克服现有扩散模型对流形结构学习不足的根本限制。
articles.why_it_matters: 从流形几何角度理解生成模型，有望提升图像生成的真实性

articles.title: CardioLens: Revealing the Clinical Reality Gap of MLLMs via Multi-Sequence Cardiac MRI Evaluations
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.00123v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance on public medical benchmarks, yet existing evaluations often remain weak proxies for clinical use, relying on isolated inputs and simplified recognition-style tasks. We introduce CardioLens, a leakage-resistant evaluation testbed for multi-sequence Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance (CMR), constructed from private hospital archives through a rigorous report-to-QA construction an
articles.title_cn: CardioLens：揭示多模态大模型临床真实差距
articles.summary_cn: 通过多序列心脏 MRI 评估发现当前多模态大模型在公开医学 benchmark 上的高分存在虚高，在真实临床场景下准确率大幅下降，暴露了从 benchmark 到 clinical deployment 的巨大鸿沟。
articles.why_it_matters: 临床部署前的真实场景验证至关重要，benchmark 高分不等于可用

articles.title: SENSE: Semantic Embedding Navigation with Soft-gated Evaluation for Retrieval-based Speculative Decoding
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.00021v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) inference by employing a lightweight draft model to propose candidate tokens, which are verified in parallel by the target model, without compromising generation quality. articles.title_cn: SENSE：语义嵌入导航提升检索增强投机解码
articles.summary_cn: SENSE通过语义嵌入导航替代传统字符串匹配，结合软门控评估机制动态决定是否接受草稿Token，显著提升检索增强投机解码的命中率和加速比，在保持生成质量不变的前提下实现高效推理。
articles.why_it_matters: 语义级检索匹配让投机解码更精准，LLM推理加速再进一步

articles.title: DLLM-JEPA: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures for Masked Diffusion Language Models
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.00091v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have reshaped self-supervised representation learning in vision. The recent LLM-JEPA ported JEPA to autoregressive language models but inherited two steep costs from the causal-attention substrate: it demands explicit multi-view data (e.g., text-code pairs), and it requires two gradient-carrying forward passes per step. articles.title_cn: DLLM-JEPA：JEPA架构迁移至掩码扩散语言模型
articles.summary_cn: 研究者将视觉领域成功的JEPA联合嵌入预测架构适配到掩码扩散语言模型，克服了LLM-JEPA在自回归模型上需要多视图数据和高昂双路前向传播成本的问题，为语言模型自监督学习开辟新范式。
articles.why_it_matters: JEPA跨模态迁移成功，语言模型预训练范式或将迎来变革

articles.title: CSRP: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Chinese Text Correction via Reinforcement Learning with Efficiency-Aware Rewards
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.00020v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) based Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) systems face two critical challenges: general-purpose models lack specialized linguistic priors for subtle grammatical distinctions, and Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with Maximum Likelihood Estimation fails to optimize for precision-focused metrics, leading to systematic over-correction. We propose CSRP, a three-stage framework that progressively builds correction capabil
articles.title_cn: CSRP：思维链+强化学习的中文纠错新范式
articles.summary_cn: 将思维链推理与效率感知奖励的强化学习结合用于中文语法纠错，解决通用大模型缺乏专用纠错知识和传统系统依赖大量标注数据的问题，在 CGEC 任务上取得 SOTA 效果。
articles.why_it_matters: CoT+RL 组合为中文 NLP 任务提供了高效的微调范式

articles.title: ToolGate: Token-Efficient Pre-Call Control for Tool-Augmented Vision-Language Agents
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.03054v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Tool-augmented vision-language agents can acquire external perceptual evidence through OCR, detection, segmentation, and other tools, but executing every proposed tool call is costly and sometimes unnecessary. We study the pre-call control problem: after a ReAct-style VLM agent proposes a perceptual tool call, should the call be executed, or skipped before its output enters the context? Across five benchmarks, we find that the baseline agent exhib
articles.title_cn: ToolGate：VLM Agent 工具调用预筛选
articles.summary_cn: 提出 ToolGate 机制，在多模态 Agent 执行工具调用前判断是否必要，跳过不必要的 OCR、检测等调用，以极低计算开销减少无效工具调用，显著降低 Agent 运行 token 消耗。
articles.why_it_matters: 工具调用预筛选是降低 AI Agent 运行成本的关键优化

articles.title: Hallucination Is Linearly Decodable from Mid-Layer Hidden States in Quantized LLMs
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.02628v1 Announce Type: new

articles.title_cn: 量化 LLM 的幻觉信号可在中间层线性解码
articles.summary_cn: 在三款 7B-8B 开源模型（Llama-3.1、Mistral、Qwen2.5）4-bit 量化版本中发现：LLM 的幻觉倾向在中间层隐藏状态中存在线性可分离信号，可在生成前通过简单线性探针检测。
articles.why_it_matters: 幻觉检测可在输出前完成，为安全部署 LLM 提供低成本方案

articles.title: BitsMoE: Efficient Spectral Energy-Guided Bit Allocation for MoE LLM Quantization
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.00079v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models reduce per-token computation through sparse expert activation, but their deployment remains memory-intensive because all expert weights must be kept resident in memory. Existing MoE compression methods struggle in the ultra-low-bit regime: pruning irreversibly removes model capacity, while coarse-grained quantization fails to allocate bits according to heterogeneous expert and weight-direction importa
articles.title_cn: BitsMoE：频谱能量引导的MoE混合精度量化
articles.summary_cn: BitsMoE提出基于频谱能量引导的差异化比特分配方案，对MoE大语言模型的不同专家层采用不同精度量化，在保持模型容量的同时实现超低位宽压缩，解决了MoE模型显存占用过大的部署难题。
articles.why_it_matters: MoE模型部署成本高，差异化量化可大幅降低推理硬件门槛

articles.title: Geometry-Aware Tabular Diffusion
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.02607v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Tabular synthesis is critical for privacy-preserving sharing and augmentation, yet diffusion models rely on implicit mechanisms to capture inter-column relationships. We introduce Geometry-Aware Tabular Diffusion (GATD), which augments tabular diffusion denoisers with pairwise angles and lengths computed from column value differences and used as inputs and auxiliary targets. Our MLP instantiation achieves state-of-the-art benchmark performance whi
articles.title_cn: 几何感知表格扩散模型
articles.summary_cn: 引入列间 pairwise 角度和长度作为几何先验注入表格扩散模型的去噪过程，使其显式建模列依赖关系，克服传统方法依赖隐式学习列间联系的局限，在隐私保护的表格数据合成任务中取得突破。
articles.why_it_matters: 几何先验注入扩散模型可提升隐私保护表格数据合成质量

articles.title: SAGE: A Novelty Gate for Efficient Memory Evolution in Agentic LLMs
articles.summary:
arXiv:2605.30711v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Agentic LLMs must continuously decide whether newly extracted facts should be added, merged with existing memories, or ignored, yet prior work has focused more on retrieval and storage than on principled write-side control. articles.title_cn: SAGE：新颖性门控实现Agent LLM高效记忆进化
articles.summary_cn: SAGE提出新颖性门控机制，让Agent LLM自主判断新获取的事实应新增、合并还是忽略，解决了Agent记忆系统持续膨胀和冗余积累的问题，在长期交互和多步任务中保持高效记忆管理。
articles.why_it_matters: Agent记忆管理是长期自主运行的关键瓶颈，SAGE给出实用方案

articles.title: NumLeak: Public Numeric Benchmarks as Latent Labels in Foundation Models
articles.summary:
arXiv:2605.30393v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Public numeric benchmarks appear in pretraining, so an evaluation that conditions on a date may be measuring memorized recall rather than out-of-sample skill. We introduce NumLeak, a measurement framework that combines API-boundary probes on production models with a white-box controlled validation on an open causal LM. articles.title_cn: NumLeak：公开基准测试成基础模型标签泄露源
articles.summary_cn: 研究发现公开数值基准测试出现在预训练数据中，导致模型可能通过记忆而非泛化取得高分。NumLeak提出系统化检测方法，揭示许多模型在流行基准上的「高分」实为数据污染的假象。
articles.why_it_matters: 基准测试污染问题比想象更严重，模型评估方法需系统性改革

articles.title: Auditing LLM Benchmarks with Item Response Theory
articles.summary:
arXiv:2605.30504v1 Announce Type: new

We introduce an Item Response Theory-based indicator that surfaces likely mislabels at 95% precision in the top 200 examples across seven preference and multiple-choice benchmarks using responses from 114 models, outperforming a supervised classifier. We trace these errors to mechanical labeling heuristics, upstream annotation mistakes in
articles.title_cn: 基于项目反应理论的LLM基准测试审计方法
articles.summary_cn: 利用项目反应理论（IRT）审计LLM基准测试质量，发现许多广为使用的基准存在标签错误、难度失衡等问题，且这些错误会随下游基准传播和放大，论文提出自动化审计框架以提升评测可靠性。
articles.why_it_matters: 不可靠的基准导致不可靠的模型比较，IRT审计应成为标准流程

articles.title: World Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures, Methodologies, Reasoning Paradigms, and Applications
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.00133v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: World models, internal simulators that learn the structure and dynamics of an environment, have emerged as a central paradigm in the pursuit of artificial general intelligence, enabling agents to predict, plan, and reason within learned representations. Despite rapid progress across reinforcement learning, robotics, autonomous driving, and video generation, the field lacks a unified framework integrating its diverse architectural choices, training
articles.title_cn: 世界模型综述：架构、方法论与应用全景
articles.summary_cn: 系统梳理世界模型的研究进展，涵盖强化学习、机器人、自动驾驶和视频生成等领域的架构设计、推理方法和应用场景，追踪该领域通向AGI的核心技术路线和最新突破。
articles.why_it_matters: 世界模型是AGI的关键拼图，从业者应系统了解最新全景

articles.title: A Multi-Domain Red Teaming Framework for Safety, Robustness, and Fairness Evaluation of Medical Large Language Models
articles.summary:
arXiv:2606.00027v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across healthcare, yet existing benchmarks fail to capture model behavior under adversarial or ethically complex conditions common in clinical practice. We developed a multi-domain red teaming framework evaluating eleven contemporary LLMs across 690 clinically grounded scenarios spanning nine domains and over 150 subcategories. Scenarios incorporated adversarial transformations, and responses
articles.title_cn: 医疗LLM多领域红队测试：安全与公平性评估
articles.summary_cn: 构建覆盖690个临床场景的多领域红队测试框架，评估11个主流LLM在对抗性条件和伦理复杂场景下的安全性、鲁棒性和公平性，揭示现有模型在真实医疗环境中的严重不足和潜在风险。
articles.why_it_matters: 医疗AI部署前必须通过对抗性安全测试，否则可能危及患者安全

articles.title: 一颗288核的至强6+，为什么能同时运行500个Agent？
articles.summary: 过去两年，AI基础设施行业有一个几乎无人质疑的共识：GPU决定AI的上限。从大模型训练到推理部署，产业的关注点几乎都围绕着GPU展开。显存够不够大、带宽够不够高、Token吞吐量能达到多少，成为衡量AI基础设施能力的核心指标。但Agent的出现，正在改变这套逻辑。与传统聊天机器人不同，Agent并不只是完成一次问答，而是需要持续执行任务。它需要调用工具、访问数据库、浏览网页、管理记忆系统，甚至不断创建和调度新的子Agent协同完成工作。当AI开始从生成答案转向执行任务，一个长期被GPU光环掩盖的角色重新回到了舞台中央——CPU。Computex 2026台北国际电脑展期间，英特尔发布了首款基于Intel 18A工艺打造的数据中心处理器——至强6+（代号Clearwater Forest）。这款处理器拥有288个能效核（E-Core），还拥有一个非常吸引人的特性，在实际测试中，一颗288核至强6+可以轻松同时部署400至500个Agent。这背后折射出的，并不仅仅是一颗新CPU的发布，而是Agent时代AI基础设施底层逻辑的一次深刻变化。一颗CPU能同时运行500个Agent的关键是什么
articles.title_cn: 英特尔至强6+ 288核同时运行500个Agent
articles.summary_cn: 解析英特尔至强6+处理器在Agent场景下的表现：288核CPU通过高效内存架构和工具调用优化，可同时运行500个AI Agent，挑战了「Agent必须依赖GPU」的行业共识，为Agent基础设施提供新方案。
articles.why_it_matters: CPU在Agent场景展现竞争力，AI基础设施格局可能重塑

articles.summary:

Abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) enable a unified model to solve various vision tasks through prompting. They have shown promising performance in semantic understanding. However, 3D understanding still largely relies on expert vision models with complex task-specific designs. The key argument this work wants to make is that VLMs are native 3D learners. Our in-depth large scale study shows that 1) focal length unification, 2) text-based pixel referenc
articles.title_cn: VLM3：视觉语言模型是天然的 3D 学习器
articles.summary_cn: 最新研究 VLM3 证明视觉语言模型（VLM）具备原生 3D 学习能力，无需专门的 3D 架构即可理解和推理三维空间关系，为通用视觉智能体在物理世界中的应用开辟了新路径。

articles.title: 星海图新一代具身基础模型G0.5发布，全面提升零样本泛化能力，让机器人边思考边行动
articles.summary: 过去，机器人听到“帮我把毛巾放进洗手池”——它只会机械地执行一串预设动作。现在，我们让G0.5做到了：先想——毛巾在哪？洗手池在哪？应该先拿起毛巾，再移动过去，最后放下。边思考，边行动。这一能力依托于我们最新的 VLA（视觉-语言-行动）模型架构设计：让同一个模型、同一套权重，同时完成推理与行动，让机器人拥有“行动中的思考能力”。言出法随：零样本泛化至新物体、新环境、新指令G0.5 在 R1 Lite 机器人上，零样本（未经任何该场景的微调），仅凭自然语言指令直接驱动机器人完成操作任务。模型从未见过当前的环境布局、物体类别和指令组合，却能实时理解指令意图、分解动作并输出流畅的双臂控制。这正是 G0.5 “言出法随”的开箱即用能力——一个模型，一句话，直接干活。从“记住任务”到“学会操作”过去，机器人学习一项新任务通常意味着：重新采集数据、重新微调模型、重新适配场景。它们可以出色地完成被训练过的任务，却很难泛化到新的物体、新的环境和新的指令。我们通过大规模、多任务预训练，让 G0.5 形成了可迁移、可组合的操作智能。抓取、放置、推拉、开合、移动等原子动作，不再是单个任务中的固定片段，而是
articles.title_cn: 星海图发布新一代具身基础模型 G0.5：让机器人边思考边行动
articles.summary_cn: 星海图发布新一代具身基础模型 G0.5，基于 VLA（视觉-语言-行动）架构实现零样本泛化能力的大幅提升——机器人不再是机械执行预设动作，而是能够先理解场景再规划行动，边思考边操作。

articles.title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS
articles.summary: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now generally available on AWS, giving enterprises a new path to build with OpenAI through the AWS environments, controls, and procurement workflows they already use. Customers can get started with OpenAI on AWS and move faster from evaluation to production.
articles.title_cn: OpenAI 前沿模型及 Codex 正式登陆 AWS
articles.summary_cn: OpenAI 的前沿模型和 Codex 编程智能体现在已在 AWS 上全面可用，企业用户获得了一条通过 AWS 使用 OpenAI 技术的新路径，两大巨头从竞争走向深度合作。

articles.title: 扣子 3.0 正式上线，开启Agent 团队协作新方式
articles.summary: 6月1日，扣子 3.0 正式上线，扣子手机端 （iOS / Android）、电脑端（Mac OS / Windows）、网页端三端全量更新。 扣子 3.0 提出了 AI 团队协作方式的全新架构，将 Agent 带入更完整的工作现场。在扣子 3.0 中，Agent 可以被创建、接入和随时调度，任务可以被放进项目中拆解、分配和沉淀，行业技能包可以为复杂任务提供更专业的能力起点。而扣子的网页端、桌面端和手机 App 端，则让 Agent 有机会与用户的文件、本地设备和工作场景接通，让 AI 能够更深入地参与到真实的生产现场。 自定义Agent开箱即用，支持云端创建和本地接入 过去，用户通过单个 Agent 完成特定任务，但面对复杂任务时，单一Agent助手的局限性逐渐显现。在扣子 3.0 中，Agent 不再只有一种形态：用户能够添加自定义 Agent，组建自己的 Agent team。 扣子 3.0 支持接入本地 Agent。用户可将本地使用的 Claude Code、Codex CLI、OpenClaw等工具接入扣子，接入后，这些本地 Agent
articles.title_cn: 字节跳动扣子 3.0 正式上线：开启 Agent 团队协作新方式
articles.summary_cn: 字节跳动旗下 AI 应用开发平台扣子（Coze）3.0 版本正式全端上线，提出 AI 团队协作的全新架构，将多个 Agent 组合为协作团队完成复杂工作流，代表了 Agent 应用从单兵作战走向团队协作的趋势。

articles.title: Nvidia chases $200B CPU market with AI agent PCs from Microsoft, Dell, and HP
articles.summary: If Nvidia has cracked a way to bring AI agents easily, safely, and usefully to the masses, it could — and should — be big.
articles.title_cn: NVIDIA 联手微软、戴尔、惠普进军 2000 亿美元 CPU 市场，推出 AI Agent PC
articles.summary_cn: NVIDIA 与微软、戴尔、惠普合作推出 AI Agent PC，正式切入价值 2000 亿美元的 CPU 市场。如果 NVIDIA 成功将 AI Agent 安全、易用地带给大众消费者，这将是一次 PC 产业格局的重大重塑。

articles.title: Alphabet plans to raise $80B to pay for AI buildout
articles.summary: "The company is experiencing strong demand for its AI solutions and services from enterprises and consumers, at levels that are exceeding the company’s available supply," Alphabet said in its statement.
articles.title_cn: Alphabet 计划融资 800 亿美元用于 AI 基础设施建设
articles.summary_cn: Alphabet 宣布计划筹集 800 亿美元巨资以支持 AI 基础设施建设，公司表示来自企业和消费者的 AI 需求远超现有供给能力，反映出 AI 算力军备竞赛的进一步升级。

articles.title: Anthropic files to go public
articles.summary: Anthropic, now an AI powerhouse that has landed top-tier enterprise customers, was once considered an underdog in the emerging world of large language models.

articles.summary_cn: AI 明星公司 Anthropic 正式提交上市申请，这家曾被视为行业黑马的公司在拿下大量顶级企业客户后，正通过 IPO 加速扩张，标志着 AI 行业进入资本密集型竞争的新阶段。

articles.title: Welcome NVIDIA Cosmos 3: The First Open Omni-model for Physical AI Reasoning and Action
articles.title_cn: NVIDIA Cosmos 3 发布：首个开放的物理 AI 推理与行动全模态模型
articles.summary_cn: NVIDIA 发布 Cosmos 3，这是首个开放的面向物理 AI 的全模态基础模型，能够同时进行推理、世界建模和行动生成，为机器人、自动驾驶和智能空间等物理 AI 系统提供统一的基础能力。
